name: cal_hole_sizes
purpose: Vertical-hole shrink test, 1.8-3.4mm, debossed labels are diameter x10.
notes: Pick M2/M2.5/M3 tap + clearance sizes from this.

name: cal_screw_boss
purpose: Screw boss split/bite test 1.6-2.8mm pilot, labels are diameter x10.
notes: Drive real M2/M2.5/M3 screws in; note which pilots split.

name: cal_clearance_pegs
purpose: 5mm pin clearance test 0.1-0.6mm with three removable handled pegs.
notes: Labels are clearance x10. Pegs are separate bodies with feet.

name: cal_cable_tunnels
purpose: Open-top cable channels 4/6/8/10mm for 5264 servo leads and silicone wire.
notes: Labels debossed in channel floors.

name: fit_servo_bracket_c03
purpose: STS3215 ear-hang bracket plate, 0.3mm body clearance.
notes: Servo hangs by ears exactly like a real mount. Caliper-check ear dims first.

name: fit_servo_bracket_c05
purpose: STS3215 ear-hang bracket plate, 0.5mm body clearance.
notes: Print both, keep whichever clearance fits best.

name: fit_horn_disc
purpose: 25T horn recess + slotted bolt-circle (12-16mm) + M3 center.
notes: Slots absorb unknown horn bolt circle; measure and lock in.

name: fit_wheel_slice_76
support: tree fills the shallow horn recess; pops out
purpose: 76mm OD wheel slice with horn recess. Tests wheel-mode mounting and wobble.
notes: Full wheel is 30mm wide; this 12mm slice tests the interface first.

name: dummy_sts3215_solid
purpose: Solid STS3215 stand-in with ears/shaft/cable stub; mates with bracket plates.
notes: Ear position/pitch not datasheet-confirmed - caliper-check on arrival.

name: hinge_horn_lug
purpose: Direct horn-to-link lug (single-shear). Compactness reference only.
notes: Use double-shear for real load paths.

name: hinge_clevis_tongue
purpose: Double-shear clevis (7mm gap) + matching 6mm tongue link, M3 pin.
notes: Best starting hinge. Add one washer per side. A 2-DOF leg chain (hip+knee) needs 2.

name: hinge_knuckle_m3
purpose: Two-piece coaxial knuckle hinge, M3 pin, free +/-90deg travel.
notes: Slide halves together sideways, then pin.

name: hinge_flexure_leaves
purpose: PLA flexure comparison, 2.0/1.6/1.2mm leaves printed on the bed.
notes: Comparison only - not a leg hinge strategy.

name: link_rocker
purpose: Three-arm rocker with 14/20/26mm radii, horn recess so it mounts on a servo.
notes: For pushrod/bellcrank experiments.

name: link_fourbar_pair
purpose: Two SEPARATE parallel bars, 45-95mm holes at 10mm, for four-bar tests.
notes: v1 had these fused together - now they are two bodies.

name: link_coupler_pair
purpose: Two short links (20-60mm holes) - coupler + ground to close a four-bar loop.
notes: A four-bar needs 4 links: 2 parallel bars + coupler + ground (or bolt to the pose grid as ground).

name: link_femur_adjustable
purpose: Adjustable femur beam 60-110mm axis-to-axis in 5mm steps (staggered rows).
notes: Edge row = 10mm grid, far row = +5mm. CAD baseline 65mm. Print 2 for a two-leg stance test.

name: link_tibia_adjustable
purpose: Adjustable tibia beam 75-120mm axis-to-axis in 5mm steps.
notes: CAD baseline 85mm. Print 2 for a two-leg stance test.

name: jig_pose_grid
purpose: 150x90 15mm-grid M3 pose board for pinning beams into stance shapes.
notes: Bolt beams to any grid hole with M3x12+nut.

name: dummy_lipo_hoovo_2200
purpose: HOOVO 3S 2200 envelope (104x34.5x24.5, ~180g) - the pack that was ordered.
notes: Empty envelope, not a mass dummy. Optional print.

name: dummy_xt90s_loop
purpose: XT90-S anti-spark loop key hand-clearance envelope.
notes: Empty envelope, not a mass dummy. Optional print.

name: dummy_ubec_5v5a
purpose: 5V 5A UBEC approximate envelope.
notes: Empty envelope, not a mass dummy. Optional print.

name: dummy_xt60_xt30_pdb
purpose: XT60-to-8xXT30 PDB approximate envelope.
notes: Empty envelope, not a mass dummy. Optional print.

name: dummy_phone_mi9se
purpose: Mi 9 SE slab. Prefer the real phone for layout; print only if needed.
notes: Empty envelope, not a mass dummy. Optional print.

name: dummy_esp32_devkit
purpose: ESP32 DevKitC approximate envelope.
notes: Empty envelope, not a mass dummy. Optional print.

name: dummy_bus_servo_adapter
purpose: Bus Servo Adapter approximate envelope.
notes: Empty envelope, not a mass dummy. Optional print.
